Quantity:   Guyatone HD-2 Harmonic Distortion Pedal The Guyatone HD-2 Harmonic Distortion offers a faithful replication of that classic tone, with some added benefits to boot. The HD-2 is a transistor distortion based on the most popular vintage designs. Its dual clipping stages provide a considerable amount of distortion yet with a note-to-note definition and dynamic responsiveness not found in other current market pedals. Level and Distortion controls offer variable volume and clipping and as on our OD-2 we’ve foregone a tone control in order to reproduce the instrument’s tonal characteristics more accurately.
